why: Each row has one striped, one black and one white triangle, and the black dot is once on the left side, once on the right side and once at the bottom. Row 3 still needs a white triangle with the dot on the left side, which is option 3. Option 2 has the dot on the left but is black.
trick: Check each feature (shading, dot place, legs) separately: each one appears once per row.
note: By the same rule the legs should be the 3-leg stand, but no option has white + left dot + 3 legs; book answer C has 2 legs. Option A is white with 3 legs but its circle is hollow and on the right.
